items.title: Bill to block OpenAI's for-profit conversion gets mysteriously gutted
items.raw_content: Diane Papan is a California Assembly member introduced a bill, California AB-501, that would stand in the way of converting OpenAI from a nonprofit into a for-profit. (Stuart Russell, Yann LeCun, Lawrence Lessig, and many others including me signed a petition in its support .) Tens of billions of dollars are at stake. Here’s what AB-501 looked like back when I signed the petition a few days ago. My sources assure me that this is NOT a clerical error and that Papan’s office confirms that the change is real.
items.title_zh: 阻止 OpenAI 转型营利性公司的法案被神秘掏空
items.summary: Gary Marcus writes that California Assembly Bill 501, introduced by Assembly member Diane Papan to block OpenAI's conversion from a nonprofit to a for-profit, has been substantially gutted. He says sources and Papan's office confirm the change is real rather than a clerical error, with tens of billions of dollars at stake.

items.summary: The Whisky project says WhiskyWine will receive no further updates and will not be upgraded to Wine 8 or later. Fixes for specific apps and games such as Steam will no longer be produced, though occasional updates may still come if macOS fundamentally breaks the main app.

He argues fundraising is not validation and that startups need not pursue all-or-nothing outcomes.

items.title: Beyond Feature Importance: Feature Interactions in Predicting Post-Stroke Rigidity with Graph Explainable AI
items.title_zh: 超越特征重要性：用图可解释 AI 预测卒中后僵硬
items.summary: The study analyzes 519K stroke hospitalization records and finds that graph-based models such as Graphormer and graph attention networks outperform logistic regression, XGBoost and Transformer baselines in predicting post-stroke rigidity, reaching an AUROC of 0.75.

items.title: COIG-P: A High-Quality and Large-Scale Chinese Preference Dataset for Alignment with Human Values
items.title_zh: COIG-P：面向人类价值对齐的高质量大规模中文偏好数据集
items.summary: The authors build a human-free, LLM-based annotation pipeline over 92k filtered Chinese queries, using 15 models to generate and score chosen-rejected pairs, and release COIG-P with 1,009k preference pairs across six domains. They also train an 8B Chinese Reward Model and report 2% to 12% gains for Qwen2/2.5 and Infinity-Instruct model series on AlignBench.

items.title: Membrane: Accelerating Database Analytics with Bank-Level DRAM-PIM Filtering
items.title_zh: Membrane：利用 bank 级 DRAM-PIM 过滤加速数据库分析
items.summary: Membrane is a cooperative query-processing framework that runs scan and filter work on DRAM-based processing-in-memory while leaving other operations to the CPU, reporting 5.92x/6.5x speedups over a traditional schema on analytics benchmarks.

items.title: Findings of the BabyLM Challenge: Sample-Efficient Pretraining on Developmentally Plausible Corpora
items.title_zh: BabyLM 挑战赛结果：在发展上合理的语料上进行样本高效预训练
items.summary: The BabyLM Challenge report summarizes results from over 30 submissions on training language models within a fixed, developmentally plausible data budget, finding that winning LTG-BERT entries outperformed models trained on trillions of words.

items.title: Gradient as Conditions: Rethinking HOG for All-in-one Image Restoration
items.title_zh: 梯度作为条件：重新思考 HOG 在全能图像复原中的作用
items.summary: HOGformer is a Transformer-based all-in-one image restoration model that uses learnable Histogram of Oriented Gradients features as degradation-aware conditions, reporting state-of-the-art results across benchmarks.

items.title: Improving Multilingual Capabilities with Cultural and Local Knowledge in Large Language Models While Enhancing Native Performance
items.title_zh: 以文化与本地知识提升大模型多语言能力，同时保持母语表现
items.summary: The authors introduce Mantra-14B, a Hindi-English bilingual LLM instruction-tuned on 485K samples, reporting about a 3% average benchmark improvement in both languages and outperforming models twice its size.

items.title: Learning Object Focused Attention
items.title_zh: 学习以对象为中心的注意力
items.summary: The paper adds an object-focused attention loss to selected Vision Transformer layers so that attention concentrates on patches from the same object class, reporting better classification, out-of-distribution robustness and shape-based representations without extra inference cost.

items.title: Context-Aware Adaptive Sampling for Intelligent Data Acquisition Systems Using DQN
items.title_zh: 基于 DQN 的上下文感知自适应采样，用于智能数据采集系统
items.summary: A paper models multi-sensor adaptive sampling as a Markov decision process and uses a deep Q-network to balance data quality, energy consumption and redundancy, tested on the Intel Lab Data dataset.
